description: This PHP source file defines a class ApiCommands that provides command-line interface methods for configuring and managing SuiteCRM's V8 API, including OAuth2 key generation, user and client creation, and environment setup.

classes.name: ApiCommands
classes.description: Provides command-line functions to configure, generate keys, create clients/users, and export environment configurations for SuiteCRM's V8 API.

methods.name: apiConfigureV8
methods.description: Configures SuiteCRM's V8 API, including key generation, permission setting, user creation, and environment export.

methods.name: apiGenerateKeys
methods.description: Generates OAuth2 RSA key pair and saves them to specified files.

methods.name: apiSetKeyPermissions
methods.description: Sets file permissions for OAuth2 key files to secure access.

methods.name: apiRebuildHtaccessFile
methods.description: Rebuilds or upgrades the .htaccess file for SuiteCRM administration access.

methods.name: apiCreateClient
methods.description: Creates a new OAuth2 client in the database with a generated secret.

methods.name: apiCreateUser
methods.description: Creates a new SuiteCRM user for API access with specified credentials.

methods.name: apiExportPostmanENV
methods.description: Exports a Postman environment configuration JSON file for the API.

methods.name: outputClientCredentials
methods.description: Outputs OAuth2 client credentials (client ID and secret) in a formatted table.

methods.name: outputUserCredentials
methods.description: Outputs user credentials (username and password) in a formatted table.

methods.name: getNameCount
methods.description: Counts existing records with similar names to generate unique names for new clients or users.
